rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１３３＿００２Ugh, here goes Kaname with her￥"Cousin! Cousin!" routine again.
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿００３Guess what! The cherry blossoms￥in the Environmental Section are￥in full bloom...＝＠１３３＿００４They were so, so pretty!
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿００５Cousin! Wanna go see them￥with me right now?!
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿００７That doesn't matter at all!￥I wanted to show you, Cousin.
＊Riko＊＠１３３＿００８Oh, Kaname... So the one person￥you're dying to show is...＝＠１３３＿００９Hmm. Figures!
＊Riko＊＠１３３＿０１０Geez! I can't keep up with your￥big-brother complex.＝＠１３３＿０１２See ya!
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０１３So what?! Besides, I do NOT have￥a brother complex!!
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０１７Walking slowly among the flowers￥like this, all the bad stuff￥just seems to melt away, huh?
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０１８When we were little, we'd walk￥around looking at flowers￥together, remember?
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０１９Though all I ever did was chase￥after you, yelling "Cousin!"...
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０２５But I'm going to grow out of￥all that now!
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０２６Coming here, meeting you again￥after eight years, both of us￥candidates...
＊Kaname＊＠１３３＿０２９Hey! Don't tease me!!￥I'm trying to be serious here!
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００１You know, spending time with￥you here, I realized something.
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００２That I was really just a kid.
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００３When we met again, I was so busy￥chasing the you I remembered...＝＠１３４＿００４It never occurred to me that￥you'd changed and grown up￥since then.
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００５So I felt like I was the only￥one who'd been left behind.＝＠１３４＿００６But...
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００７People change as time goes by,￥don't they?
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿００９...I want to change too, even if￥it's only little by little.＝＠１３４＿０１０I want to be able to accept￥myself for who I am.
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿０１１Let's both do our best on the￥final exam, okay?
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿０１２Even if we don't make it... No.￥Whatever the result, we'll have￥grown up a little more, right?
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿０１４When the day comes that we go to￥Elan, instead of chasing after￥you...＝＠１３４＿０１５I want to stand￥right beside you.
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿０１８Hey! That's so mean, Cousin!＝＠１３４＿０１９Fine! When you qualify and come￥asking me to go with you, don't￥expect me to say yes!
＊Kaname＊＠１３４＿０２２I... I'm so glad I got￥to see you again!!
